headline: Congress authorized the Treasury to mint special breast cancer awareness coins, with surcharges from sales going to a breast cancer research group.
what_it_does: The law directs the Treasury Department to mint and issue up to 50,000 five-dollar gold coins, 400,000 one-dollar silver coins, and 750,000 half-dollar coins with a breast cancer awareness design. The design is to come from a juried design competition, and the coins may be sold only during 2018. Each coin sale must include a surcharge: $35 per gold coin, $10 per silver coin, and $5 per half-dollar coin. The Treasury must pay the surcharges to the Breast Cancer Research Foundation under a set distribution formula.

who_it_affects.how: People who want these commemorative coins can buy them during the 2018 sale window, and each purchase includes the added surcharge.
The foundation receives the surcharge money collected from coin sales.
Designers can enter the juried, compensated design competition to have their work chosen for the coins.

when_it_takes_effect: The coins may be issued only during the one-year period beginning January 1, 2018.
